_why: Every interactive control on the site and the test that proves it works. scripts/feature-audit.mjs crawls the RUNNING app and fails when a control is not listed here, so a new button is untested-by-default instead of silently unverified. This inventory comes from the app, not from a list someone remembered to update.

controls.whyNotCrawled: only rendered after the composer sends a description and the wizard mounts. The claiming test drives that flow and asserts Next is enabled.

controls.name: Back
controls.test: wizard.spec.ts > Back returns to the previous step with answers intact
